svg.text: A. A card opens above the button
The VoiceVisualizer bars live in a small card; the button keeps a ring. Same card shows the answer.
“Remind me to call the client at three”
Done. I set a reminder for 3 PM
and will ping you ten minutes before.
B. Only the button reacts (no card)
Smaller and quieter: bars stand around the snail, a short label sits beside it. The answer opens the normal chat bubble.
